```{r}
# sc_04_hladr_tumor.R
# Task 4: HLA-DR expression on tumour cells in EGFR-mutant vs. EGFR-WT NSCLC
#
# Question: Do tumour cells in EGFR-mutant tumours express HLA-DR (MHC class II),
# consistent with immune visibility despite a "cold" phenotype, or is HLA-DR
# absent (consistent with immune evasion)?
#
# HLA-DR genes tested: HLA-DRA, HLA-DRB1, HLA-DRB5
# Also includes the full MHC-II panel (HLA-DQ, HLA-DP) and antigen presentation
# machinery (B2M, TAP1, TAP2, TAPBP) for a broader immune-visibility score.


library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scater)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)

# ── 0. Helpers (same logic as sc_03) ─────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Assay priority:  logcounts > X > count > counts_length_scaled
# "count"                — raw integer counts (confirmed)       → log1p applied
# "counts_length_scaled" — length-scaled/tximeta counts         → log1p applied
# "X"                    — unknown; runtime peek decides         → log1p if max > 20
# "logcounts"            — scran log-normalised                  → use as-is

score_gene_set <- function(sce, genes, assay_name = NULL) {
  if (is.null(assay_name)) {
    for (a in c("logcounts", "lognormcounts", "normcounts",
                "X", "count", "counts_length_scaled")) {
      if (a %in% assayNames(sce)) { assay_name <- a; break }
    }
  }
  if (is.null(assay_name)) stop("No recognised assay found.")
  genes_present <- intersect(genes, rownames(sce))
  if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
    message("  WARNING: none of the genes found: ", paste(genes, collapse = ", "))
    return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(sce)))
  }
  message(sprintf("  [%s] %d / %d genes present: %s", assay_name,
                  length(genes_present), length(genes),
                  paste(genes_present, collapse = ", ")))
  mat <- assay(sce[genes_present, ], assay_name)

  needs_log <- assay_name %in% c("count", "counts_length_scaled")
  if (assay_name == "X") {
    peek <- as.numeric(as(mat[seq_len(min(5, nrow(mat))),
                              seq_len(min(200, ncol(mat)))], "dgCMatrix"))
    needs_log <- max(peek, na.rm = TRUE) > 20
  }
  if (needs_log) mat <- log1p(mat)
  as.numeric(Matrix::colMeans(as(mat, "dgCMatrix")))
}

get_gene_expr <- function(sce, gene, assay_name = NULL) {
  if (is.null(assay_name)) {
    for (a in c("logcounts", "lognormcounts", "normcounts",
                "X", "count", "counts_length_scaled")) {
      if (a %in% assayNames(sce)) { assay_name <- a; break }
    }
  }
  if (!gene %in% rownames(sce)) return(rep(NA_real_, ncol(sce)))
  v <- as.numeric(assay(sce[gene, ], assay_name))
  needs_log <- assay_name %in% c("count", "counts_length_scaled") ||
               (assay_name == "X" && max(v, na.rm = TRUE) > 20)
  if (needs_log) v <- log1p(v)
  v
}

# ── 1. Gene lists ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

hla_dr_genes <- c("HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DRB5")

mhc_ii_broad <- c("HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DRB5",
                   "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DQA2", "HLA-DQB1",
                   "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1",
                   "HLA-DMA", "HLA-DMB", "HLA-DOA", "HLA-DOB",
                   "CD74")

antigen_presentation <- c("B2M", "TAP1", "TAP2", "TAPBP",
                           "HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C",
                           "CALR", "PDIA3", "CANX")

# IFN-γ response (often drives MHC-II upregulation)
ifn_response <- c("STAT1", "STAT2", "IRF1", "IRF3", "IRF7",
                   "IFIT1", "IFIT2", "IFIT3", "MX1", "OAS1", "ISG15", "CXCL10")

# EGFR / oncogenic signatures (to confirm tumour identity)
tumor_markers <- c("EPCAM", "KRT7", "KRT8", "KRT18", "KRT19",
                    "SFTPC", "SFTPB", "NKX2-1",  # LUAD markers
                    "TP63", "KRT5", "KRT6A",       # LUSC markers
                    "EGFR", "KRAS", "STK11", "KEAP1")


cd_tum  <- as.data.frame(colData(sce_tum))
message(sprintf("Tumour cells: %d", ncol(sce_tum)))

# ── 4. EGFR status in tumour cells ───────────────────────────────────────────

message("\n=== EGFR status in tumour cells ===")
# EGFR_mutant = TRUE where "EGFR-mutation" == "mutated" (set in sc_02)
if ("EGFR_mutant" %in% names(cd_tum)) {
  print(table(cd_tum$EGFR_mutant, useNA = "ifany",
              dnn = "EGFR_mutant (TRUE=mutated)"))
  egfr_available <- any(!is.na(cd_tum$EGFR_mutant))
} else {
  message("EGFR_mutant not found — run sc_02_egfr_status.R first.")
  egfr_available <- FALSE
}

# ── 5. Compute HLA-DR and related scores for each tumour cell ────────────────

message("\n=== Scoring HLA-DR and antigen presentation genes ===")

cd_tum$score_HLA_DR  <- score_gene_set(sce_tum, hla_dr_genes)
cd_tum$score_MHC_II  <- score_gene_set(sce_tum, mhc_ii_broad)
cd_tum$score_APC     <- score_gene_set(sce_tum, antigen_presentation)
cd_tum$score_IFN     <- score_gene_set(sce_tum, ifn_response)

# Individual HLA-DR gene expression
for (gene in c("HLA-DRA", "HLA-DRB1", "HLA-DRB5", "CD74", "B2M")) {
  cd_tum[[paste0("expr_", gsub("-", "_", gene))]] <-
    get_gene_expr(sce_tum, gene)
}

# Save per-cell table
write.csv(cd_tum[, c(names(cd_tum)[1:min(5, ncol(cd_tum))],
                      "EGFR_mutant",
                      "score_HLA_DR", "score_MHC_II", "score_APC", "score_IFN",
                      grep("^expr_", names(cd_tum), value = TRUE))],
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "tumor_hladr_scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
message("Saved: tumor_hladr_scores.csv")

# ── 6. Statistical comparison: EGFR-mut vs. EGFR-WT ─────────────────────────

if (egfr_available) {
  egfr_mut <- cd_tum$EGFR_mutant == TRUE  & !is.na(cd_tum$EGFR_mutant)
  egfr_wt  <- cd_tum$EGFR_mutant == FALSE & !is.na(cd_tum$EGFR_mutant)

  test_cols <- c("score_HLA_DR", "score_MHC_II", "score_APC", "score_IFN",
                 grep("^expr_", names(cd_tum), value = TRUE))

  cat("\n=== Wilcoxon tests: EGFR-mut vs EGFR-WT (tumour cells) ===\n")
  stats_list <- lapply(test_cols, function(col) {
    x_mut <- cd_tum[[col]][egfr_mut]
    x_wt  <- cd_tum[[col]][egfr_wt]
    x_mut <- x_mut[!is.na(x_mut)]
    x_wt  <- x_wt[!is.na(x_wt)]
    if (length(x_mut) < 3 || length(x_wt) < 3) return(NULL)
    wt <- wilcox.test(x_mut, x_wt, exact = FALSE)
    data.frame(
      feature      = col,
      n_EGFRmut    = length(x_mut),
      n_EGFRwt     = length(x_wt),
      median_mut   = round(median(x_mut), 4),
      median_wt    = round(median(x_wt),  4),
      pct_pos_mut  = round(100 * mean(x_mut > 0), 1),
      pct_pos_wt   = round(100 * mean(x_wt  > 0), 1),
      p_value      = wt$p.value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  stats_df <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), stats_list))
  stats_df$p_adj <- p.adjust(stats_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  stats_df <- stats_df[order(stats_df$p_adj), ]
  print(stats_df)
  write.csv(stats_df, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tumor_hladr_egfr_stats.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved: tumor_hladr_egfr_stats.csv")
}

# ── 7. Plots ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

message("\n=== Generating HLA-DR tumour plots ===")

plot_tum <- cd_tum %>%
  filter(!is.na(EGFR_mutant)) %>%
  mutate(EGFR_group = ifelse(EGFR_mutant, "EGFR-mut", "EGFR-WT"))

egfr_colours <- c("EGFR-mut" = "#e31a1c", "EGFR-WT" = "#1f78b4")

# 7a. Violin plots for HLA-DR score, MHC-II, APC, IFN
make_violin <- function(data, y_col, y_label) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = EGFR_group, y = .data[[y_col]], fill = EGFR_group)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.75, scale = "width") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = egfr_colours) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label, fill = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
}

p_hladr  <- make_violin(plot_tum, "score_HLA_DR", "HLA-DR score")
p_mhcii  <- make_violin(plot_tum, "score_MHC_II", "MHC-II broad score")
p_apc    <- make_violin(plot_tum, "score_APC",    "Antigen presentation score")
p_ifn    <- make_violin(plot_tum, "score_IFN",    "IFN-response score")

# Individual gene violins
p_hla_dra  <- make_violin(plot_tum, "expr_HLA_DRA",  "HLA-DRA expression")
p_hla_drb1 <- make_violin(plot_tum, "expr_HLA_DRB1", "HLA-DRB1 expression")
p_cd74     <- make_violin(plot_tum, "expr_CD74",      "CD74 expression")
p_b2m      <- make_violin(plot_tum, "expr_B2M",       "B2M expression")

violin_panel <- (p_hladr | p_mhcii | p_apc | p_ifn) /
                (p_hla_dra | p_hla_drb1 | p_cd74 | p_b2m) +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "HLA-DR / antigen presentation in tumour cells",
    subtitle = sprintf("n = %d tumour cells", nrow(plot_tum))
  )

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "hladr_tumor_violin.png"), violin_panel,
       width = 16, height = 9, dpi = 150)
message("Saved: hladr_tumor_violin.png")

# 7b. Dot plot: MHC-II and APM genes, EGFR-mut vs. WT
dot_genes_hla <- intersect(
  c(hla_dr_genes, "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DQB1", "HLA-DPA1", "HLA-DPB1",
    "CD74", "B2M", "TAP1", "TAP2", "TAPBP", "STAT1", "IRF1"),
  rownames(sce_tum)
)

if (length(dot_genes_hla) >= 3) {
  assay_use <- Filter(function(a) a %in% assayNames(sce_tum),
                      c("logcounts", "X", "count", "counts_length_scaled"))[1]

  dot_mat <- as.matrix(assay(sce_tum[dot_genes_hla, ], assay_use))
  dot_df  <- as.data.frame(t(dot_mat))
  dot_df$EGFR_group <- ifelse(cd_tum$EGFR_mutant == TRUE, "EGFR-mut", "EGFR-WT")
  dot_df  <- dot_df[!is.na(dot_df$EGFR_group), ]

  dot_long <- dot_df %>%
    pivot_longer(-EGFR_group, names_to = "gene", values_to = "expr") %>%
    group_by(EGFR_group, gene) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_expr   = mean(expr, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_express = 100 * mean(expr > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_dot <- ggplot(dot_long,
                  aes(x = EGFR_group, y = gene,
                      size = pct_express, colour = mean_expr)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 9), name = "% expressing") +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Mean expr") +
    labs(title = "MHC-II / antigen presentation machinery in tumour cells",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "hladr_tumor_dotplot.png"), p_dot,
         width = 6, height = 8, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved: hladr_tumor_dotplot.png")
}

# 7c. UMAP: HLA-DR score on full dataset, tumour cells highlighted
umap_name <- if ("X_umap" %in% reducedDimNames(sce)) "X_umap" else
             if ("UMAP"   %in% reducedDimNames(sce)) "UMAP" else NULL

if (!is.null(umap_name)) {
  umap_all        <- as.data.frame(reducedDim(sce, umap_name))
  names(umap_all) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  umap_all$is_tumor     <- tumor_mask
  umap_all$EGFR_group   <- "Non-tumour"
  umap_all$EGFR_group[tumor_mask & cd$EGFR_mutant == TRUE  & !is.na(cd$EGFR_mutant)] <- "EGFR-mut"
  umap_all$EGFR_group[tumor_mask & cd$EGFR_mutant == FALSE & !is.na(cd$EGFR_mutant)] <- "EGFR-WT"

  umap_all$HLA_DR_score <- NA_real_
  umap_all$HLA_DR_score[tumor_mask] <- cd_tum$score_HLA_DR


# 7d. % HLA-DR-positive tumour cells per patient, by EGFR group
id_col <- c("patient_id", "patient", "PatientID", "sample_id",
            "sample", "donor", "orig.ident")[
  c("patient_id", "patient", "PatientID", "sample_id",
    "sample", "donor", "orig.ident") %in% names(cd_tum)][1]

if (!is.na(id_col) && egfr_available) {
  hladr_thr <- 0   # any detectable HLA-DRA expression
  patient_summary <- cd_tum %>%
    filter(!is.na(EGFR_mutant)) %>%
    mutate(EGFR_group  = ifelse(EGFR_mutant, "EGFR-mut", "EGFR-WT"),
           HLA_DR_pos  = expr_HLA_DRA > hladr_thr) %>%
    group_by(.data[[id_col]], EGFR_group) %>%
    summarise(
      n_tumor_cells  = n(),
      pct_HLA_DR_pos = round(100 * mean(HLA_DR_pos, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_HLA_DR    = round(mean(score_HLA_DR,  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      mean_MHC_II    = round(mean(score_MHC_II,  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
      .groups        = "drop"
    )

  print(patient_summary)
  write.csv(patient_summary, file.path(OUT_DIR, "tumor_hladr_per_patient.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  message("Saved: tumor_hladr_per_patient.csv")

  # Box plot: % HLA-DR+ cells per patient, grouped by EGFR status
  p_pat <- ggplot(patient_summary,
                  aes(x = EGFR_group, y = pct_HLA_DR_pos, fill = EGFR_group)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = egfr_colours) +
    labs(title   = "% HLA-DR+ tumour cells per patient",
         x = NULL, y = "% HLA-DRA+ cells",
         caption = "Each point = one patient") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "hladr_pct_positive_per_patient.png"), p_pat,
         width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 150)
  message("Saved: hladr_pct_positive_per_patient.png")
}

message("\n=== HLA-DR tumour analysis complete ===")
message("\nAll outputs written to: ", OUT_DIR)

```
